rows.currentScript: Line 21 says the party 'entered' the room. Lines 21 and 22 say it 'consisted of only five'. These five are Mr Bingley and the people who came with him. So a party here is a group of people who arrive together. It is not everyone at the assembly, and it is not the ball.
rows.whyRewrite: 'Lines 21 and 22 say it 'consisted of only five'' - the quoted words are wholly on line 21 (line 22 begins 'altogether:'); a line number names the line that holds the words. Cite line 21 for the quote and line 22 for the list of who the five are.

rows.currentScript: Read line 29 and find the words 'growing out of the top'. Something growing out of the top of a wall is a plant. Line 30 adds 'the window-shape' as a second, separate thing. So the elder is the growing one, a small tree or bush. An older member of a family cannot grow out of a wall.
rows.whyRewrite: 'Read line 29 and find the words 'growing out of the top'' - the phrase runs across two lines: line 29 ends 'growing out of', 'the top' is on line 30. Cite lines 29 and 30 (or quote only 'growing out of' for line 29). Otherwise the round-1 quotation-mark fault is fixed and the reasoning is sound.

rows.currentScript: Read line 45 and find the words 'being useful, or at least officious'. The words 'or at least' set officious just below being truly useful. So officious means trying to be useful but pushing a little too far. Line 45 says the speaker 'drew near', but that is what was done. It has nothing to do with holding an office.
rows.whyRewrite: Round-1 form faults fixed and quotes verbatim (line 45), but 'So officious means trying to be useful but pushing a little too far.' announces the 'pushing too far' half of the key - 'or at least' only shows it is less than truly useful. The evidence for pushing is available ('I would not be driven quite away', lines 40-41; 'drew near him again', lines 45-46) and is not used. Also 'but that is what was done' does not make clear to a child that it sets aside the 'going up to someone again' option.

rows.currentScript: Read on from line 8, past the shouting. He goes 'without even waiting to put on his coat'. So he rushed out suddenly. Locking and eating are the other senses.
rows.whyRewrite: Currently APPROVED and served, but a quotation is cited to one line when its words run onto the next (walk-quote-check, line citations carried forward). Keep everything true about it; fix the line citation so it names every line that holds the quoted words.
